title: Stop active livestreams when a call ends
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[vtc] Stop active livestreams when a call ends
Spec (3cbb0c4): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L740: "When a call ends, the server stops every VTCRecording for the call in state `\"recording\"` or `\"paused\"` and every VTCLivestream in state `\"starting\"` or `\"live\"`, as if a moderator had set each to `\"stopped\"`."
Code: crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/call.rs:651-693; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/media.rs:612-656; crate-jmap-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:23-24
Now: end_cascade calls stop_recordings only. Livestreams stay starting or live after the call ends.
Change: Add stop_livestreams, which sets state to stopped and stoppedAt for starting/live livestreams of the call. Call it next to stop_recordings for the call and each breakout room.
